intent: Analyse the gas usage and security of my ERC-20 token contract and produce an audit report with severity ratings.

spec.goal: Get the gas usage and security of their ERC-20 token contract analysed and documented in an audit report with severity ratings.
spec.deliverable: A written audit report on the ERC-20 token contract covering gas usage and security findings, each with a severity rating.
constraints: The audit covers both gas usage and security of the ERC-20 token contract.
Every finding must carry a severity rating.
The report is limited to the user's ERC-20 token contract and does not extend to other work.
done_criteria: The report contains a gas usage analysis of the contract.
The report contains a security analysis of the contract.
Each finding is assigned a severity rating.
The report is presented as a structured audit report.
spec.summary: You want your ERC-20 token contract reviewed for gas usage and security, with the results delivered as an audit report that rates each finding by severity.
